description: Lay out sources and uses for a business acquisition and solve the senior loan as the remainder. Takes the price, working capital, closing costs, buyer and other equity, a seller note with its terms, senior loan terms and annual cash flow; returns the funding gap, each source as a share of total uses, the first-year debt service, the coverage by year and a cash-flow sensitivity. Use when the user asks how the whole purchase gets funded.

annualCashFlow.description: Annual cash flow available for debt service. In US dollars.

buyerEquity.description: Buyer cash going into the deal. In US dollars.

cashAvailable.description: Buyer cash on hand, to warn when the equity spends the reserve. In US dollars.

closingCosts.description: Closing costs funded at close. In US dollars.

debtPayoff.description: Existing debt of the target retired at close. In US dollars.

liquidityReserve.description: Cash the buyer intends to keep back. In US dollars.

otherEquity.description: Equity from anyone else: a partner, an investor, a rollover. In US dollars.

purchasePrice.description: The purchase price. In US dollars.

retainedAnnualService.description: Annual payments on debt the business keeps after closing. In US dollars.

sellerAmortYears.description: Seller note amortization. Longer than the maturity leaves a balloon. In years.

sellerNote.description: Seller note principal. In US dollars.

sellerRate.description: Seller note rate. Annual rate in percentage points. 9.25 means 9.25%.

sellerStandbyInterest.description: What happens to interest during standby months. "none": no interest accrues. "accrue-simple": interest accrues and is due at maturity. "capitalize-monthly": interest is added to principal each month.

sellerStandbyMonths.description: Months at the start of the seller note with no payment.

seniorAmount.description: A fixed senior loan amount. Omit to solve the senior loan as the remainder. In US dollars.

seniorRate.description: Senior loan rate. Annual rate in percentage points. 9.25 means 9.25%.

targetDscr.description: A coverage target to compare against, such as 1.25.

workingCapital.description: Working capital funded at close, beyond anything in the price. In US dollars.
